name: Nemesvámos (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nemesvámos: a blue shield with a red-clad horseman on a white horse, with a helm, a crest and blue and yellow mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nemesvámos arms with helm, crest and mantling
